theme: An open day to lock the trip down before the girls arrive.
greeting: You're back on the ground in St. Pete, Dan, and the calendar is wide open. One clear day to settle the last logistics before the household grows by four tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: St. Pete bed for tonight
needsAttention.detail: You landed TPA yesterday and the Sept 20-22 landing-gap lodging still shows open in Todoist. You need somewhere in the St. Pete area for tonight before Tuesday's 3pm pickup.

needsAttention.title: Full-size SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20-Oct 5 SUV out of TPA is a p1 still marked open. Tuesday's pickup and the Orlando drive both ride on it, and you're already here.

needsAttention.title: Kids' passport packet and appt
needsAttention.detail: The passport task is due today: reschedule the four-kid appointment for after the return, and close the packet -- DS-11s printed but unsigned, birth-certificate copies, and a State Dept check (~$400, no cards).

needsAttention.title: Pickup, Orlando, groceries
needsAttention.detail: The girls come to you and Mike tomorrow at 3pm, then the drive to Marriott Royal Palms in Orlando. Slot a grocery stop en route so the villa kitchen gets used.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets for six
needsAttention.detail: The Orlando weekend is set except the tickets. Confirm park-reservation rules and check whether a Magic Kingdom Halloween party night changes which park you do.

flagged.title: LinkedIn messages awaiting reply
flagged.detail: Two LinkedIn messages are waiting on you -- worth a look given you're actively networking for board seats.

flagged.title: Venmo: $1,300 to Paul Singer
flagged.detail: The Croatia sailing charter payment cleared this afternoon. Confirmation only, nothing to do.

flagged.title: Bahamas catch-and-cook flotilla
flagged.detail: Mike looped in Nautilus's Fede about a Catch, Clean & Cook flotilla in the Bahamas; you're cc'd, no reply needed yet.

flagged.title: Independent Managers Club intros
flagged.detail: Lubrano and Chie Mitsui are lining up placement-agent and Mercer introductions; you're cc'd on the thread.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and retail -- NYT Cooking, Hilton, Chairish, Folio, and the Maine and St. Pete locals.

recipe.title: Roasted pumpkin soup
recipe.why: Early autumn is peak season for winter squash and pumpkins at the market.

tasks.title: Call dermatologist to book wart removal

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar -- the morning is yours before the pace picks up.
Still wide open, a clear stretch for the bookings that have been waiting.
A quiet last night before a fuller house tomorrow.
